buffer.notes: Default. Official LinkedIn Analytics API partner. Free tier covers reactions, comments, impressions -- shares excluded on free tier, confirmed via testing.

taplio.notes: Working alternative. Not a confirmed official LinkedIn API partner -- has documented history of prior ToS enforcement tied to its access methods. Kept as a fallback, not the default.

zernio.notes: Not yet built -- see STRV-96. URN-based exact matching once available, cleaner than Taplio's content-fallback matching. Free for up to 2 connected accounts.
